tokens.name: surface-ink
tokens.usage: Fill of bottom sheets and cards, the app ground, and every static element inside a sheet: read-only info rows, tables and chart cards. Label color on accent.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Only for interactive elements inside a sheet: fields, code boxes, secondary buttons, tab groups, and selectable or swipeable rows. Never for static content.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-ink (17.1:1) and surface-raised (13.7:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Helper text, secondary lines in list rows, the dialling code and the info icon, on surface-ink (7.3:1) and surface-raised (5.9:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fill of the single primary action on a screen. Its label is on-accent (11.5:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon color on accent.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Location pins on maps, the leading icon in fields and info rows, and the warning icon on confirm cards, on surface-ink (8.3:1) and surface-raised (6.7:1).

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed color of inline text links on surface-ink (11.0:1).

tokens.name: handle
tokens.usage: Drag handle bar at the top of a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: ground-field
tokens.usage: Placeholder ground behind onboarding screens, standing in for the aerial field photo. Text on it reaches only 2.8:1, so copy stays inside sheets.

tokens.name: ground-map
tokens.usage: Placeholder ground for map screens, standing in for satellite imagery.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Your union would like to send you updates.
styles.usage: Every sheet and card title, questions and instructions included: centered, with title-padding above and below.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The code comes as a WhatsApp message.
styles.usage: Helper text, explanations, field input and info-row labels.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Values in info rows, the first line of list rows, and emphasis inside body copy.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Data tables only: header and cells (bold for the first column). Never for body copy, buttons, fields or labels.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Gap between a sheet and the screen edge; gap between list rows.

tokens.name: gap-inline
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside fields, info rows and text links.

tokens.name: gap-stack
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between items inside a sheet; horizontal padding inside fields and info rows.

tokens.name: sheet-padding
tokens.usage: Inner padding of bottom sheets and cards.

tokens.name: title-padding
tokens.usage: Extra space above and below a sheet title, on top of gap-stack.

tokens.name: button-padding-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards on all corners; bottom sheets on the top two corners only.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Every button, primary and secondary.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Text fields, code boxes, info rows and list rows.

tokens.name: radius-handle
tokens.usage: The sheet drag handle.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Round header icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and cards lifted off the map or photo ground.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Height of every button.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Height of text fields and info rows.

tokens.name: icon-button
tokens.usage: Round header buttons (back, settings).

tokens.name: info-icon
tokens.usage: Box the 16px info icon sits in on explanation cards. No ring or border.

tokens.name: handle-width
tokens.usage: Width of the sheet drag handle; its height is 4px.
